description: Predmetom zákazky je zabezpečenie elektronického prístupu do softwaru na plánovanie pracovného času posádok a údržby lietadiel a vrtuľníkov LÚMVSR a to za účelom zabezpečenia prepravy vládnych a ústavných činiteľov. Okrem rozdelenia práce umožní tento elektronický prístup do softwaru, vzhľadom na neustále meniace sa lety, aktívne sledovať jednotlivé prílety/odlety a podľa aktuálnej situácie rozdeľovať jednotlivé úkony údržby leteckej techniky. title: ARGONAUT – S-Band Medium Gain Antenna Assembly  (S-MGAA)
description:
OHB System AG, a subsidiary of the European space and technology group OHB SE, is acting as subcontractor to Thales Alenia Space (TAS-I) who has been contracted by the European Space Agency (ESA) as prime Contractor for the realization of the ARGONAUT mission. Under its subcontract, OHB is responsible for the EPS, TT&C and GNC subsystems up to flight readiness. 
The objective of the present procurement is the selection of the subcontractor for the Argonaut LDE S-Band Medium Gain Antenna Assembly (S-MGAA). As part of the TT&C subsystem, the S-MGAA is responsible to provide a directional S-band communication link with the relay satellite enabling the LDE to transmit telemetry, video, and receive commands while maintaining antenna pointing toward the relay satellite.
The procurement of the S-MGAA will be conducted in line with the “ESA Best Practices for the Selection of Subcontractors by Prime Contractors in the frame of ESA’s Major Procurements” (reference ESA BEST PRACTICES IPC(2012)65, rev.2).
Notwithstanding the complete list of countries identified in the Special Provision for visibility purposes, the ITT letter of invitation will contain a dedicated set of geographical return requirements/targets to be considered.

title: COMMERCIAL OFF-THE-SHELF (COTS) DIGITAL TO ANALOG CONVERTER PRE-EVALUATION - EXPRO PLUS
description: There is a limited availability of qualified/radiation hardened DAC with high resolution. Currently,with just one 16-bit high speed and one high precision low speed qualified DAC available from twodifferent manufacturers. At the moment, state of the art DAC have 16 or higher bits, low powerconsumption and good linearity at medium speed. Such DAC have high demand, therefore oftencommercialdevices are proposed without any knowledge on radiation robustness in heavy ions fordestructive event (SEL: Single Event Latch-up)and functional interrupt (SEFI: Single EventFunctional Interrupt).As the organization of the test campaign is often lengthy and the realization of test set up requireslarge effort and specific skills, the benefit of this activity would be to offer a set of relevant radiationdata on state of art DAC to designers in an early stage of the design of an instrument.This activity encompasses thefollowing tasks:- Perform a market survey and select 4 best candidates (selected based on precision, knowledge of the technology, power consumption, speed and input/channel configuration, linearity). The reference performance will be therefore the following: <1Wpower dissipation with few tens of mW in power down mode, precision higher or equal 16bits, INL (integral nonlinearity) and DNL (differential non linearity) lower or equal to 1LSB (least significant bit),speed higher than 125Msps (Mega samples per seconds).- Preparation of test set up for both SEL and SEFI test campaign- Performance of the heavy ions test and analysis of test results- Analysis of the results to identify which technology can be considered for future Space application.
